geometry: Original complete scanned mesh, no repair, decimation or vertex-color texture. Scanned holes remain and are audited.
camera: Official camera poses converted to mesh coordinates. Render camera uses fx for both focal axes; original fy is recorded and the sub-percent approximation is measured.
material: Assigned uniform two-sided diffuse material, known simulator truth; not recovered real reflectance.
split: Fit direction only on train condition, view 0, seed 101. All other views/conditions/seeds are held out from fitting. No hyperparameter tuning on heldout images.
test_inputs: True relative changes of simulated sun azimuth/elevation are supplied. Angles are in scene coordinates, not calibrated geographic headings or actual capture times.
limits: Real scanned geometry with synthetic materials and lighting. Component direction/visibility evaluation, not a learned BRDF, full IRIS comparison, or demonstrated sim-to-real transfer. Direct-only images are privileged synthetic observations.
